messages:
Kate Ramirez: :wave: Heads-up: a few small docs PRs just landed — two tiny link fixes, a JS SDK snippet update, and a migration-guide wording tweak. PR that triggered the preview failure: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4187. CI/docs-preview is failing for that one. Who can pick up quick reviews or fixes?

docs-bot: Build failed for PR #4187 — preview canceled. Log excerpt:
```
ERROR: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mkdocs_material'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/mkdocs", line 5, in <module>
    import mkdocs
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'mkdocs_material'
```

Priya Shah: I can take the JS snippet and the mkdocs fix. Looks like requirements.txt missing the theme dependency. I can open a tiny PR to add it and bump the preview. ETA ~2 hrs.

Mike Chen: :raising_hand: I'm on docs reviewer rotation this week, happy to review the migration guide after Priya's fixes land. Can we aim for a short merge window at 5pm PT so infra has time to run previews?

Dan O'Neill: If you want faster merges, tag PRs with `docs/quick` and the docs-rapid bot will auto-assign a reviewer. Also FYI, preview builds have been flaky when the sidebar TOC exceeds ~50 items — might be unrelated but worth watching.

Kate Ramirez: Thanks @Priya — can you also switch the JS snippet to the streaming client pattern? Current snippet in the PR is:
```js
// old snippet
const r = await redwood.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize...' })
console.log(r.text)
```
Proposed replace with:
```js
// streaming snippet
for await (const chunk of redwood.stream.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize...' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```
This is tiny but we want consistency across SDK examples.

Priya Shah: Yep — I'll include the requirements fix + swap the snippet in the same branch, then push. I'll tag @Mike for the migration-guide review once the preview is green.

Mike Chen: Ack. I'll hold off until you tag me. If I don't hear by 4:45pm PT, ping me and I'll prioritize it.

Kate Ramirez: I added a short checklist in the PR body for reviewers (smoke check, lint, confirm preview link). Also added a note to the migration guide about the API rename so reviewers know what to look for. cc @Dan for the `docs/quick` label automation.

docs-bot: Preview re-run queued for PR #4189 (after requirements update).

Dan O'Neill: I'll add an automation rule to auto-assign `docs-rotation` when `docs/quick` is applied and notify the reviewer on call.

Kate Ramirez: Awesome — thanks everyone :rocket: If anything blocks the merge I'll post another ping in this thread.
